Element.name: version
Element.Documentation: Associates a language resource with a pattern that indicates its version; the recommended way is to follow the semantic versioning guidelines (http://semver.org) and use a numeric pattern of the form major_version.minor_version.patch

Element.name: timeCoverage
Element.Documentation: Indicates the time period that the content of a resource is about

Element.name: geographicCoverage
Element.Documentation: Indicates the geographic region that the content of a resource is about; for countries, recommended use of ISO-3166
